notes.title: New Demo Release!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Engineers!

A big update to the Cubetory Demo just dropped. 

Notably, it includes : 
- New map generation : Smaller by default, but adjustable
- Metrics
- Power System improvements
- Balancing changes to recipes
- Sandbox mode
- Steam Cloud support
- Improved controls
- Custom map support

Please enjoy, and let me know in the discord if you run into any issues :)
[/p]

notes.title: Demo Bugfixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hello!👋 [/p][p]

[/p][list][*][p]Updated machine graphics[/p][/*][*][p]Visual update to machine menus[/p][/*][*][p]Visual update to upgrade menu[/p][/*][*][p]Keep delete selected after doing a delete [/p][/*][*][p]Undo now works with belt rotation[/p][/*][*][p]There's now a cursor indicator to help aligning deletes and copy pastes[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the settings page to avoid keybindings being cutoff by a scroll-bar[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with being able to click through the save game page[/p][/*][*][p]Added the production panel to stampers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where stamper windows would flicker in size[/p][/*][*][p]Cube rate of production numbers should be more stable now[/p][/*][*][p]Added splash rate to geyser mouse overs[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting toggle to hide tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loading stamper state, the outputs weren't persisted correctly.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small bugfix patch
notes.notes: [p]A new version of the demo was just released. Changes of note :[/p][list][*][p]The simulation engine changes should lead to much better performance on older PCs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with borderless windows and multiple monitors[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the tutorial to help with learning the mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked keybinding to allow re-binding left click[/p][/*][/list][p]Development of the full game is going well, and should be able to start internal testing in the discord sometime in august.[/p]

notes.title: Public playtest starts now!
notes.notes:
Greetings engineers!

I'm happy to announce that the Playtest is now live. Here's a changelog from the previous playtest held in discord : 

[list]
[*] Progression cleaned up, the game is now based on rate of production.
[*] Added challenges to the desert biome.
[*] Fixed a variety of placement bugs
[*] Added high-contrast mode and mouseover indicators for colors
[*] Contextual hints appear in important menus
[*] Added a difficulty selection. Cube wizard is really hard.
[*] Various performance improvements
[/list]

Please give it a shot and let me know what you think!

I'll be creating a special role in discord for anyone who beats the demo/playtest on the Cube Wizard difficulty for the hardcore automation fans among us.
